title: Now at This Evening Hour
description: Now at This Evening Hour in Tonic Solfa to BOYLSTON, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns of the Greek Church (Edinburgh and London, 1900), headed “An Evening Hymn”.
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Short Metre (6.6.8.6), and this page sets them to BOYLSTON; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Now at this eve-ning hour, O Thou, my Christ, to Thee, Thou Word of God, E-ter-nal Light, All grate-ful prais-es be.

lines: O Thou, my Christ, to Thee,
Thou Word of God, Eternal Light,
And in Thyself one glorious orb
That he the splendour might reflect
And daily rise, till he himself

source: John Brownlie, Hymns of the Greek Church (1900)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns of the Greek Church; set to BOYLSTON by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
